name: Sora no Mayoibito
source:
The protagonist finds himself wandering in a world of loss, unable to remember exactly what was missing. Through the help of people in his life, he finally starts remembering...

[From [url=http://at2006.haeleth.net/game.php?id=15]zalas[/url]]
translation:
主人公发现自己在一个失落的世界中徘徊，无法确切记住失去了什么。在身边人们的帮助下，他终于开始回忆起来……

[引自[url=http://at2006.haeleth.net/game.php?id=15]zalas[/url]]
